grok_report.summary: The briefing's core facts (oil surge, Hormuz disruption, Jones Act waiver, general price levels) are directionally accurate and roughly consistent with verifiable data, but it materially understates the severity of the US-Iran conflict by framing an active war with collapsed shipping as mere 'tensions,' and is imprecise about which oil benchmark crossed $85. It also omits the actual catalysts behind the tech/cybersecurity rally (Palantir's blowout earnings and an AI-hacking safety story) that better explain CRWD's move than pure technical structure. Stock prices and technical tags appear broadly plausible but could not be independently confirmed to the cent for all tickers.
